features:
ULTIMATE STEALTH SCRIPT V6.4
Hidden ESP | Hitbox | Social Tracking | CoreUI

PvP Dominance: Perfect for all competitive and team games.

Command recognition: Instant tactical advantage: If you play in a mode where there are teams, the script finds your team and the opponent's team and highlights them with color, providing instant visual confirmation.

Your team (Ally): 🟢 glows green.

Opponents (Enemy): 🔴 are highlighted in red.

Friends (NEW): 🟠 Your friends are highlighted in Orange, preventing accidental attack or confusion.

Hitbox Management:

Customizable hitbox expansion for enemies only.

Landing Protection: The mistake in Roblox is that if you have hitboxes enabled and the player for whom the hitbox will be increased gets into a transport (or sits), he may freeze and exit the game. But in my script, the hitboxes shrink to their normal size when boarding a transport or sitting, which prevents crashes in Roblox.

Visuals and Tracking (Enhanced):

Phantom Fix (FIXED): The script now uses a robust cleanup system. ESP and Health Bars disappear instantly upon player death (no more lingering "ghost" visuals).

Infinite Names (NEW): Ability to remove name tag distance limits, allowing you to see player names across the entire map.

Crosshair (NEW): Adjustable center-screen crosshair for improved aiming precision.

Stealth: The menu and all the elements are hidden in CoreGui, which ensures 99% invisibility.

Note: You are not protected from the risk of being banned if you behave too suspiciously!

Special Feature: Also in some games (Prison Life) there is an additional feature that allows you to kill players by tapping on them (Stable God Mode Kill Click).

(Toggle Menu: Right Shift)
